intro: Celebrating young people who are making Limerick a better place to live, work and grow up.
title: Meet the talented people within Limerick City
aboutBody: Meet the entrepreneurs, athletes, creatives and community voices recognised by Swap'N'Serve for their talent, ambition and contribution to Limerick.

honourees.bio:
Ryan is a 20-year-old entrepreneur who has already achieved more than many do in their entire careers. One of Ireland’s most promising entrepreneurs, he has the ambition to become one of the best in the world over the next five years.

Ryan completed a Y Combinator batch, the prestigious entrepreneur accelerator based in San Francisco, where participants receive $500,000 for 7% of their company. The other past Limerick participants highlighted here are the Collison brothers, who founded Stripe. Ryan founded Hoplite.

https://app.hoplite.sh/

https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-morrissey-834256271/
honourees.name: Ryan Morrisey

honourees.bio:
Ben has 20,000 followers, four million views and 400,000 likes on TikTok. One of the purest and funniest people I have had the pleasure of meeting, he has the talent to run his own television show and become a national hero if given the right opportunities.

https://www.tiktok.com/@benoshaugnessy
honourees.name: Ben O’Shaugnessy

honourees.bio:
Darren is a centre-back for Treaty United who has been on trials with teams including Blackburn Rovers in England and Lecce FC in Italy. A kind and generous person, he is a great role model for the children who look up to him.

https://treatyunitedfc.com/player/darren-nwankwo/

honourees.bio:
Pa owns Pa’s Chipper in Thomondgate. A great entertainer, he draws queues of people eager to try his food and have a conversation with him.

He runs boxing classes for young people in Limerick City and is exceptionally generous, giving out free food to people experiencing homelessness and to many customers, including myself.

https://www.tripadvisor.ie/Restaurant_Review-g186621-d33594056-Reviews-Pa_s_Chipper-Limerick_County_Limerick.html
honourees.name: Pa O’Halloran

honourees.bio: A Southill local, Craig aims to improve his neighbourhood and the wider Limerick community. He hopes to study youth work in college and dedicate himself to bringing life back to Limerick.
honourees.name: Craig Dawson

honourees.bio:
Azeezat is one of the most talented individuals I have had the pleasure of meeting. She studies architecture at UL and, in her spare time, runs Aze’s Room, giving local creatives, musicians and poets an open mic and a place to share their skills and crafts with an audience.

https://limerickvoice.com/arts-and-culture/azes-room-open-mic-limerick/
honourees.name: Azeezat Muniru

Often described as a gentleman, Lee has done a great deal for Limerick City, serving as an ambassador and an inspiration to young people. He volunteered with Limerick Treaty Suicide Prevention in his spare time.

Following a serious injury, Lee deserves the city’s support as he recovers.

honourees.name: Mduduzi & Valentino Ncube
